authority: Static shipped-artifact analysis; original shader not executed. Public Vision76 region mapping reused from slim-pose-report.json.

common.uv: full-image normalized, y down; production stores y up and must convert points and q together

jaw.execution: 6 sequential q updates; each radius uses the second triplet index, unlike thin/chin which use the direction anchor distance

short.outside: d=minimum distance to11 closed segments; weight=clamp(1-d/radius,0,1), only when d<radius
short.nearest_segment_threshold: squared edge length>1e-6 then project t=clamp(dot(q-A,B-A)/dot(B-A,B-A),0,1); else choose A

implementation.strength: Original CPU clamps a common shape strength. Product fixes that multiplier at1 and maps it to no user parameter: PGAmount/s.amount is smoothing strength only and is not used by thin/chin/jaw/short. All4 share the same pixel-size gain. Each shape uses its own control; PGMix is applied independently to the total output later by the host adapter. No new common shape-strength UI is introduced.
implementation.sampling: All sequential coordinates are evaluated within one CIWarpKernel per face; image and all4 masks share the same method.
implementation.missing_or_invalid76: Preserve legacy face/archive and other5 analytic controls; skip thin/chin/jaw/short exactly.
implementation.unchanged: Existing thin17/chin3 index order, constants and formulas remain unchanged.

limits: No original target app/shader executed; these are static CPU/AIR observations.

The complete vendor chain is not reconstructed: narrow/V/cheek/small-head/eye algorithms and their ordering remain project approximations. Isolated jaw/short plus recovered thin/chin ordering is tested.
No new explicit yaw, pitch, roll or landmark-quality attenuation is inferred. Profile behavior follows detected 2D landmarks, as in the recovered branches.
Physical PNG checks bypass the host IOSurface adapter. Original vendor pixel equivalence and Motion/FCP1.1.2 runtime acceptance remain unverified.
Independent public Vision CGImage and CIImage detections differ slightly. Tests allow .025 normalized location difference; eye/temple displacement tests measure the actual GPU inverse field.

verification.physical_checks: Public Vision76 lower-contour response, pupil/upper-contour positions beyond support unchanged; separate CGImage Vision point locations cross-check the CIImage production path.

pre_fix_difference.jaw: axis-aligned bbox jawBand, .20 multiplier, no radiusNeighbour or lip anchor
pre_fix_difference.short: axis-aligned bbox lower field, .16 multiplier, no lower-contour polygon or nose axis
pre_fix_difference.bounds: Difference in algorithm is established. It does not by itself prove why a specific installed screenshot looks like temple movement; coordinate/isolated-control localization must be checked in actual image output.

air_excerpts.formatNote: Trailing whitespace removed from numbered excerpt; original AIR source SHA remains unchanged.
